_doc: The five missions. type: main|side. A quest starts at its first stage; scripts move it with quest.stage / quest.complete. rewards are paid on completion.

a_cold_welcome.name: A Cold Welcome
a_cold_welcome.summary: Hollowmere sent for help. You are what answered.

stages.text: Speak with Reeve Maren in the stone hall on the north side of the market square.
Find allies in town, then make camp outside the walls (press Camp or G).

rats_in_the_cellar.name: Rats in the Cellar
rats_in_the_cellar.summary: Something is scratching in the cellar of the Gilded Heron.

stages.text: Unlock the cellar door inside the Gilded Heron and clear out the rats.
Tell Bram the cellar is safe.

smiths_shipment.name: The Smith's Shipment
smiths_shipment.summary: Goblins took Tova's iron on the east road and are squatting in the old orchard.

stages.text: Recover the stolen crate from the goblins in the orchard, south-east of the square.
Bring the crate back to Tova at the smithy.

into_the_barrow.name: Into the Barrow
into_the_barrow.summary: Lights burn on the old tomb east of town, and the miller's boy has not come home.

stages.text: Leave Hollowmere by the east gate and enter the Sunken Barrow.
Find out who is waking the dead - and what became of Edrin.

hollow_king.name: The Hollow King
hollow_king.summary: Someone below the iron door is calling the dead up by name.

stages.text: Go down to the lowest chamber of the Barrow and stop the Hollow King.
Tell Reeve Maren that the Barrow is quiet.
